_comment: The new cups' arenas, in cup order (cup 23 onwards). Each entry describes the five pictures the image generator makes for it (tools/cup_arenas.py prompts): floor tile, round medallion at the centre of the floor, low wall round the floor, the tall backdrop round the arena (its top rows also make the dark vault above), pillar face. Everything static and matte: no fire, water, smoke, glow, cloth or lettering.

arenas.name: rookie
arenas.setting: a simple village training yard
arenas.floor: packed light tan earth, smoothed and trodden, with a few small pebbles and faint scuffs, divided into large squares by shallow straight grooves
arenas.medallion: a ring of pale chalky limestone set flush in the earth, with a simple bold five-pointed star of raw pale wooden planks in the centre
arenas.wall: a low solid barrier of raw pale wooden planks laid horizontally and nailed to thick posts, with a flat rail on top
arenas.backdrop: a tall stockade of raw pale timber logs standing side by side, with simple wooden walkways and ladders across it, pale tan earth at its foot, the top of the logs cut to points
arenas.pillar: the surface of a thick post of raw pale wood seen close up, its vertical grain and knots clear, with simple rope bands

arenas.name: champion
arenas.setting: a classical stone coliseum
arenas.floor: large rectangular slabs of warm beige travertine laid in a running bond, with narrow joints
arenas.medallion: a carved travertine medallion: a bold laurel wreath ring around a plain raised circle, in warm beige and pale sand tones
arenas.wall: dressed blocks of warm beige travertine with a plain projecting cornice on top
arenas.backdrop: the tiered seating of a coliseum seen from the arena: rows of round arches stacked in three tiers of warm beige travertine, the arch openings in shadow, empty of people
arenas.pillar: a fluted classical column shaft of warm beige travertine

arenas.name: ultimate
arenas.setting: an imperial hall of red porphyry
arenas.floor: polished deep red porphyry slabs with fine pale speckles, framed by thin bronze strips
arenas.medallion: a deep red porphyry disc with a bold eight-pointed star of inlaid bronze, and a plain bronze ring at its edge
arenas.wall: deep red porphyry panels framed with plain bronze mouldings and a bronze rail on top
arenas.backdrop: the tall walls of an imperial hall: tall deep red porphyry panels between plain bronze pilasters, with plain dark niches high up
arenas.pillar: a square deep red porphyry pillar with bronze bands at regular heights

arenas.name: mega
arenas.setting: a throne hall of polished black stone and gold
arenas.floor: polished black marble slabs with thin bright gold inlay lines along the joints
arenas.medallion: a polished black marble disc with a bold simple crown of inlaid bright gold in the centre and a gold ring at its edge
arenas.wall: polished black marble blocks with a band of bright gold inlay and a gold-edged top
arenas.backdrop: the tall walls of a throne hall: polished black marble with tall bright gold inlaid frames and simple gold geometric patterns
arenas.pillar: a square polished black marble pillar with bright gold inlaid vertical lines

arenas.name: vaccine
arenas.setting: a clean ceramic sanctuary
arenas.floor: glazed ceramic tiles in pale mint green and white in a simple geometric checker and diamond pattern
arenas.corner: pale mint green and white ceramic tiles
arenas.medallion: a round ceramic mosaic: a bold plain heraldic shield shape in white on a pale mint green field, with a white ring at the edge
arenas.wall: white glazed ceramic blocks with a band of pale mint green tiles
arenas.backdrop: the tall walls of a sanctuary: white ceramic panels with tall pale mint green geometric tile bands and plain arched recesses
arenas.pillar: a square pillar clad in white and pale mint green glazed tiles in vertical stripes

arenas.name: data
arenas.setting: a platform of carved teal-grey stone
arenas.floor: flat teal-grey stone slabs crossed by a bold grid of thick carved channels filled with flat dark green stone
arenas.medallion: a teal-grey stone disc with a bold square inside a circle, outlined by thick carved channels of flat dark green stone
arenas.wall: teal-grey stone blocks with thick horizontal and vertical carved channels of flat dark green stone
arenas.backdrop: tall walls of teal-grey stone blocks with bold rectangular carved channels of flat dark green stone in a stepped geometric pattern
arenas.pillar: a square teal-grey stone pillar with thick vertical carved channels of flat dark green stone

arenas.name: virus
arenas.setting: a hollow of cracked magenta-purple rock
arenas.floor: rough flagstones of magenta-purple rock with bold jagged black cracks
arenas.medallion: a magenta-purple rock disc with a bold jagged black crack pattern spreading from the centre like a star
arenas.wall: rough blocks of magenta-purple rock with short matte black thorns along the top
arenas.backdrop: a tall wall of cracked magenta-purple rock bristling with large matte black stone spikes and thorns
arenas.pillar: a pillar of magenta-purple rock wrapped in matte black stone thorns

arenas.name: nature-spirits
arenas.setting: a clearing in an ancient forest
arenas.floor: old mossy flagstones with deep green moss in the joints, among short grass
arenas.medallion: a round stone carved with a bold simple leaf shape, deep green moss filling the grooves, a ring of moss at the edge
arenas.wall: a low wall of rounded mossy stones overgrown with deep green moss and ferns
arenas.backdrop: a ring of giant ancient tree trunks with deep brown bark standing close together, thick deep green moss and leaves above them
arenas.pillar: the trunk of a giant tree with deep brown furrowed bark and patches of moss

arenas.name: deep-savers
arenas.setting: a long-drained coral reef ruin, completely dry and bleached
arenas.floor: dry pale sand-coloured stone slabs with small bleached coral and shell fragments set into them
arenas.medallion: a round slab with a bold spiral seashell carved in relief, in coral pink and pale sand tones
arenas.wall: a low wall of dry coral pink coral stone blocks with shell patterns
arenas.backdrop: a tall dry ruined wall of branching coral pink and salmon coral formations and pale sand stone, completely dry, bleached by the sun
arenas.pillar: a pillar of stacked coral pink coral stone with spiral shells set into it

arenas.name: nightmare-soldiers
arenas.setting: an old graveyard crypt
arenas.floor: worn grey-green crypt flagstones with sickly lichen stains
arenas.medallion: a grey-green stone disc with a bold simple bat with spread wings carved in relief, bone-white stone in the grooves
arenas.wall: grey-green crypt stone blocks with a row of small bone-white skull shapes carved along the top
arenas.backdrop: a tall wall of grey-green crypt stone with rows of plain weathered tombstones in front of it and stone gargoyle statues on top, no moon
arenas.pillar: a square grey-green stone pillar carved with stacked bone-white skull shapes

arenas.name: wind-guardians
arenas.setting: a stone eyrie on a high mountain peak
arenas.floor: pale blue-grey weathered stone slabs, wind-polished
arenas.medallion: a pale blue-grey stone disc with a bold pair of spread feathered wings carved in relief
arenas.wall: a low parapet of pale blue-grey weathered stone blocks
arenas.backdrop: a wide view of distant pale blue mountain peaks with simple flat shapes, under a plain clear sky that goes from pale blue at the horizon to deep blue at the top, no clouds
arenas.pillar: a square pale blue-grey stone pillar with a carved feather pattern

arenas.name: metal-empire
arenas.setting: a cold armoured hall of riveted metal
arenas.floor: heavy gunmetal steel floor plates with bold rows of rivets and rust-orange worn edges
arenas.medallion: a round gunmetal steel plate with a bold rust-orange gear wheel in relief and a riveted ring at the edge
arenas.wall: riveted rust-orange and gunmetal armour plates with a heavy steel rail on top
arenas.backdrop: tall walls of riveted rust-orange and gunmetal armour plates with large cold steel girders and big still gear wheels, no fire, no machines running
arenas.pillar: a square steel girder pillar of gunmetal with rust-orange riveted plates

arenas.name: virus-busters
arenas.setting: a fortress of cream sandstone
arenas.floor: cream sandstone flagstones with narrow cobalt blue inlay bands along some joints
arenas.medallion: a cream sandstone disc with a bold plain shield shape of cobalt blue inlay and a cobalt ring at the edge
arenas.wall: cream sandstone blocks with a cobalt blue inlay band and plain battlements on top
arenas.backdrop: the tall walls of a fortress of cream sandstone with cobalt blue inlay bands, plain shield shapes and tall narrow window openings
arenas.pillar: a square cream sandstone pillar with cobalt blue inlay rings

arenas.name: dragons-roar
arenas.setting: a long-dormant, cold volcano
arenas.floor: large square flagstones of dark charcoal-grey basalt with subtle rusty reddish-brown mineral tones, joints filled with pale grey volcanic ash, worn smooth with chipped corners and hairline cracks
arenas.medallion: dark charcoal basalt carved in low relief with a coiled eastern-style dragon seen from above, its body curling once around the centre, head and claws as simple bold shapes, grey volcanic ash in the grooves
arenas.wall: courses of large dressed blocks of dark charcoal basalt with rusty reddish-brown mineral tones, joints filled with pale grey ash, a plain projecting capstone course on top
arenas.backdrop: the towering inner wall of the crater: tall vertical hexagonal columns of dark grey columnar basalt side by side, weathered rusty-brown streaks, pale grey ash on small ledges
arenas.pillar: large stacked blocks of black obsidian and dark basalt with subtle dark grey banding, matte, chipped edges

arenas.name: jungle-troopers
arenas.setting: a stepped ruin of yellow-ochre stone deep in a jungle
arenas.floor: worn yellow-ochre stone slabs with dark green creeping vines in the joints
arenas.medallion: a yellow-ochre stone disc with a bold carved beast mask with big round eyes and fangs, in Mesoamerican style
arenas.wall: carved yellow-ochre stone blocks with a stepped key pattern and dark green vines
arenas.backdrop: the stepped terraces of a yellow-ochre stone pyramid ruin with carved friezes, overgrown with dark green jungle vines and leaves
arenas.pillar: a square yellow-ochre stone pillar carved with stacked stylised beast faces, dark vines climbing it

arenas.name: dark
arenas.setting: a starless pit of deep indigo slate
arenas.floor: deep indigo-blue slate slabs with thin bone-white inlay lines
arenas.medallion: a deep indigo-blue slate disc with bold concentric bone-white inlay rings
arenas.wall: deep indigo-blue slate blocks with a bone-white inlay band
arenas.backdrop: the tall sheer walls of a deep pit of layered deep indigo-blue slate with thin bone-white inlay rings running round it, the top fading to near black
arenas.pillar: a square deep indigo-blue slate pillar with bone-white inlay rings

arenas.name: holy
arenas.setting: a cathedral of pale grey stone
arenas.floor: pale grey stone slabs with a simple geometric pattern of darker grey stone
arenas.medallion: a round rose window design laid flat as a floor mosaic: bold flat panes of saturated red, blue, yellow and green glass in a radial geometric pattern with pale grey stone tracery
arenas.wall: pale grey stone blocks with a plain carved trefoil arch frieze
arenas.backdrop: tall pale grey stone cathedral walls with tall pointed windows filled with flat saturated multicoloured glass panes in abstract geometric patterns, seen as flat colour, no light rays
arenas.pillar: a clustered gothic column of pale grey stone

arenas.name: aqua
arenas.setting: a matte glacier cavern
arenas.floor: matte cyan-white glacier ice blocks dusted with snow, not reflective
arenas.medallion: a matte cyan ice disc with a bold simple snowflake carved in relief, white snow in the grooves
arenas.wall: matte cyan-white blocks of ice with snow on top
arenas.backdrop: the tall walls of a glacier cavern of matte cyan and white ice with large icicles hanging down, snow on the ledges
arenas.pillar: a thick matte column of cyan ice with icicles

arenas.name: blade
arenas.setting: a samurai dojo
arenas.floor: pale straw-yellow tatami mats with dark cloth borders, laid in the traditional pattern
arenas.medallion: a round red-lacquered wooden disc with two bold crossed katana blades in dark steel and a black lacquer ring at the edge
arenas.wall: a low barrier of red-lacquered wooden posts and pale wooden panels
arenas.backdrop: the walls of a dojo: red-lacquered wooden posts and beams framing plain pale paper sliding screens, with bare wooden sword racks holding wooden swords, no scrolls, no writing
arenas.pillar: a square red-lacquered wooden post with black metal fittings

arenas.name: gaia
arenas.setting: an ancient menhir circle on an autumn steppe
arenas.floor: red earth with patches of short dry golden grass and flat embedded stones
arenas.corner: red earth and dry golden grass
arenas.medallion: a flat round stone in red earth with a bold triple spiral carved deep in it
arenas.wall: a low ring of rough red-brown field stones with dry golden grass
arenas.backdrop: a wide autumn steppe of dry golden grass and red earth with a ring of tall rough standing stones and low distant hills, a plain clear pale sky
arenas.pillar: a tall rough standing stone of red-brown rock with lichen spots and carved spirals
